title: Tirana demonstrations following Klodian Rasha’s fatal police shooting
location: Tirana, including the Prime Minister’s Office and Ministry of Interior area
scope: local gathering; no evidence found that this candidate should be merged into a national event
participants_original: Euronews Albania reports hundreds of citizens rallying on Wednesday, Dec 9; RFE/RL calls the Dec 9 crowd “several dozen” in an account focused on clashes.
threshold_50_evidence: Euronews Albania’s Dec 10 report retrospectively says hundreds rallied on Dec 9; this clearly exceeds 50, though another report’s “several dozen” appears to describe people clashing rather than the full gathering.

start_date.summary: Euronews dated Dec 10 reports the gathering as Wednesday (Dec 9); RFE/RL Dec 9 gives same-day context.

location.summary: Reports place demonstrators at the Interior Ministry/PMO area and police headquarters.

demands.summary: Reports describe demands for interior minister resignation/accountability and police reform; later reports also mention calls for the prime minister’s resignation.

participants_original.summary: Euronews reports hundreds at the Dec 9 gathering; RFE/RL says several dozen clashed, not necessarily total attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Contemporaneous retrospective account says hundreds rallied Dec 9.

protester_violence.summary: Accounts report clashes, rocks/firecrackers and damage during the gathering.

state_response.summary: Reports describe tear gas/water cannon and arrests; the interior minister resigned after the protests. Opened Dec 10 body does not substantiate firing rubber bullets; those words appear in headline, so shootings stays unknown.

notes: The Dec 9 protest followed the prior police killing of Klodian Rasha; that earlier death is not coded as a protest-time state killing. Dec 10 Euronews reports hundreds on Dec 9, supporting the threshold. A Dec 9 RFE/RL report describes “several dozen” clashing; this may count a subset, and is retained as a count discrepancy. Later reports say hundreds on Dec 10 and that the interior minister resigned. Searches through January found no confirmed event closure or continuation.
open_questions: Verify whether Dec 9 RFE/RL’s “several dozen” describes only those clashing; establish episode closure/continuity after December; review national/local aggregation and organizer.

title: Shkodër gathering seeking justice for Klodian Rasha and police director resignation
location: Shkodër; town-center civic locations reported near the municipality/prefecture
scope: local gathering; no evidence found that this candidate should be merged into a national event
organizer: Civil-society callers announced the gathering; specific organizer unknown
participants_original: Euronews describes a peaceful gathering lasting about 30 minutes with “low presence,” without a count.
threshold_50_evidence: Attendance is unquantified and described only as low; evidence does not establish 50 participants.

start_date.summary: Euronews reports the Shkodër gathering on Dec 19.

location.summary: Announcement and follow-up place it in Shkodër near municipal and prefecture buildings.

organizer.summary: Pre-event notice attributes the call to civil-society actors; named organizer is not established.

demands.summary: The notice describes justice for Rasha and resignation of the local police director.

participants_original.summary: Euronews describes low attendance but publishes no count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Low presence” gives no numeric basis to determine whether 50 attended; threshold remains unresolved.

state_response.summary: Euronews reports two minors were escorted/detained with a gasoline bottle; whether this qualifies as protest-related arrests is reported but context needs review.

notes: Kept separate from Tirana because this is a separately reported local gathering in Shkodër and no evidence establishes national organization or same-event aggregation. A Dec 19 article recalls a prior Shkodër march “one week earlier” that became violent and involved damage to a Socialist Party branch; no count for that earlier gathering, so it is not combined into this Dec 19 candidate.
open_questions: Determine whether at least 50 attended; whether the two minors’ detention is properly coded as protest-related arrest; investigate the separately mentioned prior-week Shkodër march and possible relationship/ownership.
